basic_details.job_title: ISI Part-time Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) has invited applications for one Part-time Consultant (Legal) at its Headquarters at Kolkata, on part-time contract basis initially for the period of one year. The advertisement is No.REC-11/2026-86, KOL dated 04.11.2026, issued by the Chief Executive (A&F), and the last date of application submission is 27 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted by 27 December 2026. The Jobs page lists an attachment titled "Advertisement - Legal Consultant", which was not readable on the page supplied. The way of submitting the application is not specified in the notice text. Candidates should check that attachment on the official website for the eligibility details and the method of applying.

content_sections.heading: ISI Part-time Consultant (Legal) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification page does not specify the educational qualification, the age limit, the pay, the application fee, the selection process or the mode of application.

rows.details: Part-time contract basis, initially for the period of one year

content_sections.heading: About ISI
content_sections.text: The Indian Statistical Institute is based in Kolkata. This recruitment is for its Headquarters at Kolkata. The notice is issued by the Chief Executive (A&F) and is listed on the Institute's Jobs page as type "Temporary".

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is of one Part-time Consultant (Legal) on part-time contract basis. The initial period is one year. The notice page does not mention any extension, pay or allowances.
